scripts.test: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-timeout=60000 test/*.test.js && npm run test:types
scripts.test:index: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-timeout=60000 test/index.test.js && npm run test:types
scripts.test:cache: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-timeout=60000 test/cached-build.test.js && npm run test:types
scripts.test:clean-plugin: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-timeout=60000 test/clean-plugin.test.js && npm run test:types
scripts.test:dev-mode: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-timeout=60000 test/development-mode.test.js && npm run test:types
scripts.test:explicit: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-timeout=60000 test/explicit-import.test.js && npm run test:types
scripts.test:ci: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=json --check-coverage --branches 90 --functions 90 --lines 90 --statements 90 node --test --test-timeout=60000 test/*.test.js && npm run test:types
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test:ci
scripts.postpublish: git push origin && git push origin -f --tags
